title: Tight lower bounds for Lipschitz geodesically convex optimization on hyperbolic space
summary: We determine the dimension-independent first-order query complexity of minimizing a Lipschitz geodesically convex (g-convex) function on hyperbolic space. Given a ball of radius $r$ containing a global minimizer, we prove that $Ω(ζ_r/ε^2)$ queries are necessary to attain accuracy $εMr$, where $M$ is the Lipschitz constant and $ζ_r=r/\tanh r$ captures the effect of curvature. This matches the known $O(ζ_r/ε^2)$ upper bound for the Riemannian subgradient method (Zhang and Sra, 2016). This is the first query-complexity result for g-convex optimization that is tight simultaneously in curvature…
